subject: Follow-up: unit economics deep-dive & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Liu <evan.liu@fintechx.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-25T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: unit economics deep-dive & next steps

Evan / Priya — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Summary from today's discovery:
- Primary product flow: chat-based underwriting assistant + nightly batch reranker for fraud scoring.
- Expected active users (MAU) for Q4 pilot: 15k–25k; peak concurrent chat sessions ~400.
- Estimated token mix: prompts + completions average ~1,000 tokens/session, and reranker batch ~50M tokens/month (ballpark).
- Friction points: latency SLOs <= 600ms p95 for chat; strict PII handling; SOC2 evidence requested.

Pricing/volume asks we need from you (so we can model unit economics):
1) Expected monthly token volume by feature (chat vs reranker) for next 6–12 months.
2) Target budget range for inference (monthly).
3) Business KPIs you want to hit (e.g., target $/1M tokens to keep feature economics positive, CAC payback goal, margin targets).

Initial Redwood thinking (to frame discussion):
- For a production-grade LLM setup with your latency and reliability constraints, we typically see platform-level pricing in the $800–$1,200 per 1M tokens range for high-throughput, low-latency instances (this assumes a committed volume + reserved capacity).
- If we take the mid-point ~$1,000 / 1M tokens: 150M tokens/month => $150k/mo.
- Example unit-econ framing (quick, high-level):
  - Feature: underwriting chat (per MAU/month): assume 3 sessions/mo, 3k tokens total -> ~9k tokens/user -> at $1k/1M tokens = $9/user/month inference cost.
  - CAC/payback: if LTV target is $90 and CAC is $180, 12–18 month payback is unacceptable; target payback we usually see is 3–6 months for freemium-to-paid flows.
  - Margin targets vs inference: ideally inference cost < 20% of gross margin contribution per feature.

Attachments: I'm attaching a draft pricing sheet and a usage estimate template — fill in the usage tab and we can run a more precise model.

Next steps:
- Can you populate the attached usage estimates (tokens by feature/month)?
- Confirm ballpark monthly budget range (we can model a few scenarios: conservative, expected, aggressive).
- If helpful, we can propose a 3-month pilot with a committed 50M tokens/month at a discounted pilot rate and step-up pricing.

I'll wait for the estimates and will draft an initial mutual action plan + pilot terms.

Best,
Marissa
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Attachment: Redwood-pricing-sheet.pdf
Attachment: FintechX-usage-estimates.xlsx

From: Evan Liu <evan.liu@fintechx.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@fintechx.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-26T09:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: unit economics deep-dive & next steps

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap, this is super helpful. A few quick clarifications and our inputs attached: 

Clarifications / inputs:
- We ran a quick internal estimate and attached a filled-in version of your usage_estimates template. Key numbers:
  - Chat feature: projected 12M tokens/mo in pilot (15k MAU assumed), scales to 60M by month 6 under target adoption curve.
  - Reranker batch: ~50M tokens/mo in pilot, stable.
  - Total pilot tokens: ~62M/mo; expected steady-state (month 6) ~110–130M/mo.
- Budget: leadership gave a target budget band for inference of $75k–$200k/mo depending on commitments and SLA needs.
- Target $/1M tokens: leadership would like to see options in the $700–$1,100 / 1M tokens range. Anything >$1,200 would be a stretch unless paired with strong latency/availability SLAs and reserved capacity commitments.

Ask from our side:
- Can you model 3 scenarios (conservative 50M/mo, expected 100M/mo, aggressive 150M/mo) at: (a) committed reserved pricing, (b) on-demand pricing?
- Can you show feature-level $/MAU and $/feature (underwriting chat) so we can plug into our LTV/CAC model?

We'll review the attached and aim to get back with any internal questions by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks — Evan
Evan Liu
CTO, FintechX
evan.liu@fintechx.com

Date: 2026-06-26T17:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: unit economics deep-dive & next steps

Evan — great, thanks for the estimates and the clarity on budget bands. I ran the numbers quickly and attached a scenario sheet; high-level notes below.

Model assumptions (transparent):
- Pilot commit: 50M tokens/mo reserved (3 months) at pilot rate $950 / 1M tokens. Overages billed at $1,100 / 1M.
- Expected steady-state pricing (committed): 100M+: $900 / 1M; 150M+: $800 / 1M (tiered).
- On-demand (no commit): $1,350 / 1M.

3 scenario highlights (rounded):
- Conservative 50M/mo: pilot pricing -> ~$47.5k/mo (pilot rate)
- Expected 100M/mo: committed pricing -> ~$90k/mo
- Aggressive 150M/mo: committed tiered -> ~$120k/mo

Feature economics example (underwriting chat):
- Assumptions: 3 sessions/mo per MAU; 3k tokens/session -> 9k tokens/user/month.
- At $900 / 1M tokens => $8.10/user/month inference cost.
- If CAC = $60 and ARPU = $30/mo, payback looks >6 months; if we need 3-month payback, either CAC must drop to <$25 or ARPU must increase / additional monetizable features added.

Recommendations / next steps:
1) We'll prepare a 3-scenario pricing packet (attached) and an MAU->$/feature mapping table you can drop into your LTV model.
2) If leadership is okay, propose a 3-month pilot commit for 50M tokens/mo (pilot rate) — we'll draft terms and start SOC2 evidence exchange.
3) We can run a short perf test (1-hour load run) to validate p95 latency at your expected concurrency; needs sign-off for test window and a small test key.

I attached the updated pricing sheet and the three scenario decks. If this looks good, I'll generate a short MOU/PO and a DocuSign link for the pilot commit.

Thanks — looking forward.
Marissa
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood-pricing-sheet.pdf
Attachment: FintechX-usage-estimates.xlsx
